## Problem

What's missing or awkward today — a module to add, an API to expose, a mode to
extend.

## Proposed change

Concrete: which module in `src/`, what it should export, or how the CLI should
grow. Prefer additive changes and thin `bin/ffs-diff.js`.

## Impact

content is dropped and conflicts still surface markers.
